name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
